text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's your birthday? Then I'll cast a<n>spell that'll
make all your wishes<n>come true!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you two... thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. ♪ This is nothing to me. Umm,<n>okay, close
your eyes...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And picture a blue fairy in your head.<n>Then, in a
whisper, say "hyacinth,<n>cyahinth."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's the spell from <i>Ao's Magical<n>Adventures, <i>
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Hyacinth, cyahinth, hyacinthia." Then<n>you open
your eyes and trace a star<n>with your finger, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've read that book too! You draw<n>a star, then...
make a wish, was it?
